notes.title: MAGIX PC Check & Tuning 2017 Updated
notes.content:
[h1]Important changes in version 2.4.6.203 compared to version 2.4.6.191[/h1]
[list]
[*] Optimization of communication between tray application and program
[*] Bug fixing of memory leak causing higher memory consumption
[*] Fixing of problem in High Speed Mode
[*] Layoutimprovements in some dialogues
[*] Translation issues for Russia and Italy fixed
[/list]
